description: Distribution Substation Planning Toolkit (dsp-toolkit) v1.0 is a software deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Han Li, Tianzhen Hong (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL), Berkeley, CA (United States)). The Distribution Substation Planning Toolkit (DSP Toolkit) is a software suite designed to streamline the planning and optimization of distribution substations. This toolkit offers a set of tools and APIs for data curation, short-term electric load forecasting, and weather-sensitive load adjustment, making it an essential resource for utility companies, engineers, and researchers.
